policies.coincidenceProof: skeletalMorphCoincidentPair is the weaker exact POSITION+all JOINTS/WEIGHTS+all POSITION morph proof, not universal removal permission. allAttributeMorphByteIdenticalPair independently requires every base attribute and every morph channel byte-identical. Color0-equal core pairs are separately counted; any shader-specific acceptance needs the exact shader pin and separate contract.
policies.UVPreservation: No UV values, geometry, indices, skin, morphs, metadata or runtime files changed.

interpretation.measured: UV-degenerate triangles with nonzero rest area are material-frame risk on real surface; measured area/bounds do not prove screen visibility.
sourceMechanisms: Tube and lock cap vertices reuse same longitudinal V; cap polygons therefore have collinear UVs despite nonzero 3D cap area.
Ellipsoid parameter grids duplicate pole coordinates; some pole triangles have zero geometric area.
Solidify can create side walls with copied front/back UVs; this is a source hypothesis until exact editable face mapping is inspected.
limits: Joined GLB nodes retain mesh/material identity but not original Blender object-to-face ranges. Source text mechanisms cannot uniquely label an exported face as an intentional cap.
No Blender, render, occlusion, backface/shadow visibility or posed animation execution. Rest area and bounds are not screen coverage.
Analytic per-face derivative is not the official averaged Mikk frame and is never written as a replacement.
No arbitrary UV rewrite, unsafe rest-area triangle deletion, tangent averaging or asset promotion.
